# Omid Tootoonchi

> Iranian director, editor and cinema instructor in Tehran.

## Docs

- [Homepage](https://omidtootoonchi.ir/): Biography of Omid Tootoonchi, selected works with posters and years, festival selections, about section with career stats and portrait.
- [Works](https://omidtootoonchi.ir/works.html): Complete filmography from Solitude 2007 to Safe Zone 2026, featured Safe Zone project, timeline of directing, editing and teaching career.
- [Contact](https://omidtootoonchi.ir/contact.html): Collaboration inquiries for directing, editing and teaching, with links to IMDb, LinkedIn and Instagram profiles for Omid Tootoonchi.

## Films

- [Safe Zone](https://omidtootoonchi.ir/film-safe-zone.html): 2026 short fiction about a reclusive man in Tehran rehearsing Ibsen's A Doll's House as war closes in, with credits, cast and stills gallery.
- [Crumpling](https://omidtootoonchi.ir/film-crumpling.html): 2021 short fiction from editing and teaching period, embedded Vimeo film, cast list, festival award for Best Short Film Fiction at One Earth Awards.
- [Oedipus](https://omidtootoonchi.ir/film-oedipus.html): 2018 horror drama adapting classical mythology to contemporary Iran, following a vampire hunter confronting a dynastic vampire and past love, with stills.
- [Neurasthenia](https://omidtootoonchi.ir/film-neurasthenia.html): 2014 debut feature social drama about a tired Iranian man in his mid-20s, with credits, cast, stills, festival awards, Hamburg and Warsaw nominations.

## Key Facts

- Born 1986 in Tehran, Iran; based in Tehran
- Career started 2007 at Iranian Youth Cinema Society (IYCS) under Shahram Mokri
- Attended Asghar Farhadi's actor-direction workshop
- Rain (2012 short) won Best Editing and Best Directing nomination at Tehran International Short Film Festival
- Debut feature Neurasthenia (2014): Grand Prize nominee Warsaw IFF, Young Talent nominee Filmfest Hamburg
- Edited 100+ short films, commercials and reality shows; lecturer at Inverse School and IYCS
- Latest work: Safe Zone (2026 short fiction), return to directing after four-year hiatus
- Industry: Independent cinema, short fiction and social drama
